name: scroll
interaction: As the user scrolls, page elements warp and distort fluidly, creating a disorienting yet mesmerizing visual flow. Text, images, and shapes stretch, twist, and ripple in response to scroll velocity, giving the feeling of peering through a lens that refracts the entire page. The distortion intensity maps directly to scroll speed — slow scrolls yield subtle warps, while fast scrolling shatters the layout into abstract geometry.
